title: KINGTOP Spice Grinder, 2.5" Walnut Wood and Aluminum Manual Grinder
description:
About this item
Premium Materials: Crafted from real walnut wood and durable aluminum for a sleek, sturdy feel.
Smooth Manual Grinding: Precision gear grinding ensures fine, consistent texture every time.
No Mesh Screen: Larger 2.5" spice storage and easier cleaning without a built-in filter.
Comfortable Handling: Ergonomic handle fits comfortably in hand for effortless grinding.
For Dried, Shelled Spices Only: Perfect for chili, peppercorns, and other dry spices without shells.
